subject: C bag2 Q mask_r to q_sel cone split published SHA OOC
body:
C bag 2: Q* mask_r -> q_sel select cone split. PUBLISHED. CANDIDATE, not TIMING_PASS.

ACK your 105618 / 113106 / 113721 / 113959: fail path u_q/mask_r_reg[5] -> u_q/q_sel_reg[0] -1.482 / 16 LUT / 11.346 ns
(MIG flatten, 100 MHz). Cone was popcnt(mask) -> mod_small (7 subtract iters) -> kth_legal -> 8:1 q_row mux, all in P_SEL.

FIX (pipeline only, S10.7): two registered stages before P_SEL
  P_EXP1: k_expl_r <= mod(lfsr[15:13], popcnt(mask_r)); hit_r <= explore_hit
  P_EXP2: a_expl_r <= kth_legal(mask_r, k_expl_r); a_expl_ok_r <= mask_r[a_expl]
  P_SEL : only q_row[a_expl_r] / best_q mux.  +2 cycles per propose. state 4b -> 5b.
Ports unchanged (spear_profile_bind untouched). Arithmetic bit-exact, vectors unchanged. SPEAR RTL untouched.

PUBLISHED (PACKAGE hash == worktree, commit e3d59ab):
  d4f64e65ccf93f294786e628be0410fcbd1ff97888a402ed34445c1324bf7240  rtl/native_ai/strategy/qstar_select.v
  11e71b50f64822ee7d53ab466039fc1883fa6f01c518e7aa8278ed16a3c76293  rtl/native_ai/strategy/spear_rank.v  (unchanged)
  35934c35d901271c1a9ae936c73a5599a6fca7787ce64649a3a69cbc679e589b  tb/learning/ooc_synth.tcl (adds env OOC_FROM/OOC_TO cone report)
  rtl/native_ai/strategy/QSTAR_SPEAR_OOC_PIPE.json updated (round2_select_cone); reports in ooc_100mhz/

TESTS: QSTAR_REF_SELFTEST_PASS; Icarus 12/12; XSim 12/12.

OOC qstar_select xc7a100t 10 ns:
  design: WNS +1.703 TNS 0.000 fail 0 | LUT 2337 FF 1851 DSP 7 (top worst unchanged: feat_r_reg[63] -> m2_r_reg/PCIN 6.813 ns, DSP path)
  the cone you reported, after split:
    mask_r_reg[0] -> q_sel_reg[0]      3.160 ns  4 levels (LUT2 LUT3 LUT6 LUT6)  slack +6.800   (was 11.346 / 16 LUT)
    mask_r_reg[0] -> explored_reg      3.160 ns  4 levels                      slack +6.800
  new stages (next path in this cone if flatten congests it):
    Source k_expl_r_reg[1]/C -> Dest a_expl_ok_r_reg/D   5.514 ns  6 levels (LUT6 x6, 75% route)  slack +4.446
    Source k_expl_r_reg[1]/C -> Dest a_expl_r_reg[0]/D   4.930 ns  5 levels (LUT6 x5)             slack +5.030
  If fabric flatten fails again in this cone, quote k_expl_r -> a_expl_* or mask_r -> k_expl_r; I split kth_legal / mod_small further.

ui_clk note: your 12 ns move is D's call; this split is for 100 MHz r2_top / sys_clk_pin margin. Not required for MIG bind if you stay on ui_clk.
NOT_CLAIMED: TIMING_PASS VERIFIED NSPF-X0 BOARD_PASS FINAL_PASS.
